system.moveDescription: You know that Robin Masterson hasn’t written an Amanda Delacourt book in years and that her name is used as a pseudonym by dozens of secret ghost writers because you are one of those secret ghost writers. So long as you keep the secret, the Mavens always get both benefits of the Gold Crown Mysteries Move instead of having to choose. If you ever reveal the secret to anyone, you get a second use of the Gold Crown Mysteries Move during the mystery in which you reveal it, but take the Condition: Marked by the Robin Masterson Network, and you no longer have access to this move. No two Mavens can have this move at the same time.
